Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. Organizing your projects just got easier: you can now save any filtered, sorted, or grouped list configuration and return to it instantly, without rebuilding it every time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking overdue tasks, sprint backlogs, or a specific teammate's workload, your setup is always one click away. Saved Views can also be shared with your team, making it simple to give everyone the same up-to-date perspective on priorities, deadlines, or ownership. No more repeating instructions or sending screenshots of a particular filter combination — just share the view and everyone sees exactly what you see.

This feature is designed for teams who rely on lists to stay organized and want less setup and more clarity. It's live now for every paid plan, at no extra cost.

Give it a try and let us know what you think.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
